name: Mikhmon - génération automatique de tickets Hotspot
description: AUTO DÉSACTIVÉ : réactiver après configuration valide (routeur testé, profil validé, canal testé, simulation réussie). Flux jobs SafeLink : Schedule 15 min → jobs signés → config signée → stock → seuil → simulation ? → génération limitée → PDF Gotenberg → canal → callback interne signé. Tickets créés sur RouterOS (/ip/hotspot/user), visibles dans Mikhmon. Simulation : lecture seule, aucun ticket, aucun envoi.

parameters.name: caption
parameters.value:
={{ '🎟️ Tickets Wi-Fi générés

📡 Routeur : ' + ($json.routeurNom || $json.routerBaseUrl || 'Routeur') + '
👤 Profil : ' + ($json.profile || '-') + '
✅ Tickets créés : ' + ($json.generatedCount ?? 0) + '
📦 Stock : ' + ($json.stockAvant ?? '—') + ' → ' + ($json.stockApres ?? '—') + ($json.generatedAt ? '
🕐 ' + String($json.generatedAt).slice(8, 10) + '/' + String($json.generatedAt).slice(5, 7) + '/' + String($json.generatedAt).slice(0, 4) + ' à ' + String($json.generatedAt).slice(11, 16) + ' UTC' : '') }}

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: { ...i.json, status: 'no_generation', message: `Stock suffisant pour le profil ${i.json.profile}.` } }));

return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: { status: 'rejected', message: 'Génération refusée par le demandeur.', profile: i.json.profile, quantity: i.json.quantity, approvalDecisionAt: i.json.approvalDecisionAt } }));
return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: { ...i.json, tickets: [], erreur: 'Génération refusée par le demandeur (approbation ' + (i.json.approbationCanal || 'telegram') + ').' } }));

const input = $json.body ?? $json;
const env = (name, fallback = '') => $env[name] || fallback;
const asInt = (value, fallback) => { const n = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.floor(n) : fallback; };

return [{ json: {
  routerBaseUrl: String(input.routerBaseUrl || env('ROUTEROS_BASE_URL', 'https://10.x.x.1')).replace(/\/$/, ''),
  routerUser: String(input.routerUser || env('ROUTEROS_USER', 'n8n-vouchers')),
  routerPassword: String(input.routerPassword || env('ROUTEROS_PASSWORD', '')),
  profile: String(input.profile || env('MIKHMON_PROFILE', 'default')),
  hotspotServer: String(input.hotspotServer || env('MIKHMON_HOTSPOT_SERVER', 'all')),
  threshold: Math.max(0, asInt(input.threshold ?? env('TICKET_THRESHOLD', 50), 50)),
  quantity: Math.max(1, Math.min(500, asInt(input.quantity ?? env('TICKET_QUANTITY', 50), 50))),
  usernameLength: Math.max(3, Math.min(12, asInt(input.usernameLength ?? 4, 4))),
  passwordLength: Math.max(3, Math.min(16, asInt(input.passwordLength ?? 4, 4))),
  prefix: String(input.prefix ?? env('TICKET_PREFIX', '')),
  limitUptime: String(input.limitUptime ?? env('TICKET_LIMIT_UPTIME', '')),
  limitBytesTotal: String(input.limitBytesTotal ?? env('TICKET_LIMIT_BYTES_TOTAL', '')),
  deliveryChannel: String(input.deliveryChannel || env('DELIVERY_CHANNEL', 'telegram')).toLowerCase(),
  recipient: String(input.recipient || env('DELIVERY_RECIPIENT', '')),
  pdfServiceUrl: String(input.pdfServiceUrl || env('PDF_SERVICE_URL', 'http://gotenberg:3000/forms/chromium/convert/html')).replace(/\/$/, ''),
  whatsappWebhookUrl: String(input.whatsappWebhookUrl || env('WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_URL', '')),
  printNodePrinterId: asInt(input.printNodePrinterId ?? env('PRINTNODE_PRINTER_ID', 0), 0),
  printNodeApiKey: String(input.printNodeApiKey || env('PRINTNODE_API_KEY', ''))
} }];

const html = $json.html;
return [{ json: $json, binary: { data: await this.helpers.prepareBinaryData(Buffer.from(html, 'utf8'), 'tickets.html', 'text/html') } }];

return [{ json: { status: 'no_generation', message: `Stock suffisant pour le profil ${$json.profile}.`, profile: $json.profile, stockAvailable: $json.stockAvailable, threshold: $json.threshold, checkedAt: $json.checkedAt } }];

const input = $json;
return [{ json: { ...input, mikhmonVariant: String(input.mikhmonVariant || $env.MIKHMON_VARIANT || 'v3').toLowerCase(), mikhmonBaseUrl: String(input.mikhmonBaseUrl || $env.MIKHMON_BASE_URL || 'http://10.x.x.1:8087').replace(/\/$/, ''), routerTransport: String(input.routerTransport || $env.ROUTEROS_TRANSPORT || 'rest').toLowerCase() } }];

const input = $json;
return [{ json: { ...input, mikhmonVariant: String(input.mikhmonVariant || $env.MIKHMON_VARIANT || 'v3').toLowerCase(), mikhmonBaseUrl: String(input.mikhmonBaseUrl || $env.MIKHMON_BASE_URL || 'http://10.x.x.1:8087').replace(/\/$/, ''), routerTransport: String(input.routerTransport || $env.ROUTEROS_TRANSPORT || 'rest').toLowerCase() } }];

const input = $json.body ?? $json;
const env = (name, fallback = '') => $env[name] || fallback;
const asInt = (value, fallback) => { const n = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.floor(n) : fallback; };
const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(500, asInt(input.quantity, 50)));
return [{ json: {
  routerBaseUrl: String(input.routerBaseUrl || env('ROUTEROS_BASE_URL', 'https://10.x.x.1')).replace(/\/$/, ''),
  routerUser: String(input.routerUser || env('ROUTEROS_USER', 'n8n-vouchers')),
  routerPassword: String(input.routerPassword || env('ROUTEROS_PASSWORD', '')),
  profile: String(input.profile || env('MIKHMON_PROFILE', 'default')),
  hotspotServer: String(input.hotspotServer || env('MIKHMON_HOTSPOT_SERVER', 'all')),
  threshold: Math.max(0, asInt(input.threshold ?? env('TICKET_THRESHOLD', 50), 50)),
  quantity, usernameLength: Math.max(3, Math.min(12, asInt(input.usernameLength ?? 4, 4))),
  passwordLength: Math.max(3, Math.min(16, asInt(input.passwordLength ?? 4, 4))),
  prefix: String(input.prefix ?? env('TICKET_PREFIX', '')),
  limitUptime: String(input.limitUptime ?? env('TICKET_LIMIT_UPTIME', '')),
  limitBytesTotal: String(input.limitBytesTotal ?? env('TICKET_LIMIT_BYTES_TOTAL', '')),
  deliveryChannel: String(input.deliveryChannel || env('DELIVERY_CHANNEL', 'telegram')).toLowerCase(),
  recipient: String(input.recipient || env('DELIVERY_RECIPIENT', '')),
  pdfServiceUrl: String(input.pdfServiceUrl || env('PDF_SERVICE_URL', 'http://gotenberg:3000/forms/chromium/convert/html')).replace(/\/$/, ''),
  whatsappWebhookUrl: String(input.whatsappWebhookUrl || env('WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_URL', '')),
  printNodePrinterId: asInt(input.printNodePrinterId ?? env('PRINTNODE_PRINTER_ID', 0), 0),
  printNodeApiKey: String(input.printNodeApiKey || env('PRINTNODE_API_KEY', '')),
  approvalRecipient: String(input.approvalRecipient || input.recipient || env('APPROVAL_RECIPIENT', ''))
} }];

const result = await this.helpers.httpRequest({ method: 'POST', url: 'https://api.telegram.org/bot' + $env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + '/sendMessage', body: { chat_id: $json.approvalRecipient, text: $json.approvalMessage, reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '✅ Approuver', url: $json.approveUrl }, { text: '❌ Refuser', url: $json.rejectUrl }]] } }, json: true, timeout: 30000 });
return [{ json: { ...$json, approvalNotification: result, notificationSent: true } }];
return [{ json: { status: 'rejected', message: 'Génération refusée par le demandeur.', profile: $json.profile, quantity: $json.quantity, approvalDecisionAt: $json.approvalDecisionAt } }];
